## Security:

Arbitrium Studios takes the security of our software and services seriously, including all of the open source code repositories managed through our GitHub organizations, such as here in the Arbitrium Studios [Organization][AS_Org]!

***
## Reporting Security Issues:

If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in any Arbitrium Studios-owned repository, please report it to us through coordinated disclosure.

##### **Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues, discussions, pull requests, nor through the Arbitrium Studios Discord server's public channels!**

<div style="padding-bottom: 15px;"><p style="display: flex; flex-direction: row;">Instead, please send an email to <a style="text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 0.105rem; padding-left: 5px; cursor: pointer;" title="Report security issue to Arbitrium Studios" href="mailto:security@arbitriumstudios.com">security@arbitriumstudios.com</a>!</p></div>

### Please include as much of the information listed below as you can to help us better understand and resolve the issue:

  * The type of issue (e.g., buffer overflow, SQL injection, or cross-site scripting)
  * Full paths of source file(s) related to the manifestation of the issue
  * The location of the affected source code (tag/branch/commit or direct URL)
  * Any special configuration required to reproduce the issue
  * Step-by-step instructions to reproduce the issue
  * Proof-of-concept or exploit code (if possible)
  * Impact of the issue, including how an attacker might exploit the issue

<p style="padding-top: 5px;">
    This information will help us locate the reported issue and patch it more quickly...
</p>
